name: 1-JAC
description: 1-JAC was a reprogrammed LOM-series protocol droid that worked as a bounty hunter during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 9 BBY, he was on the planet Daiyu when a bounty was placed on the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi, whom 1-JAC subsequently searched for, eventually encountering him on Daiyu's rooftops.
